name: DGLD Tokenized Gold
oneLiner: DGLD is Gold Token SA's tokenized physical gold from Swiss vaults, each token redeemable for 1 troy ounce of allocated LBMA PAMP-refined gold.
collateral: LBMA Good Delivery PAMP® gold bars allocated in insured Swiss vaults operated by MKS PAMP SA (1 DGLD = 1 troy ounce)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for physical PAMP® gold through Gold Token SA; minimum 1 gram, no custody or transfer fees

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: As of June 30 2026, DGLD closed the Ethereum-Base bridge path and redeployed Base as an independently gold-backed native issuance. Cross-chain exposure is issuer-managed multichain mint/redeem rather than a live canonical rollup bridge supply path.

mintAuthority.summary: DGLD is issued by Gold Token SA. On Ethereum the MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by a single issuer EOA (which also owns the ProxyAdmin). On Base, the discontinued OP bridge was replaced on June 30, 2026 by an independently gold-backed native deployment whose MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by the issuer EOA.

controls.label: Gold Token SA issuance backend
controls.evidence: Gold Token SA mints DGLD against allocated PAMP gold bars (1 DGLD = 1 troy oz) and burns on 1:1 physical redemption; supply is issuer-controlled with no permissionless mint route.

controls.label: DGLD Ethereum MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE — issuer EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295039: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xb1c1bc081e49b8f4bb4e1960c2f7d9cd9dff8b9d) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb1c1bc...) = true. eth_getCode on 0xb1c1bc... = 2 bytes (EOA confirmed). DGLD ETH (0xa9299c...) is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy (EIP-1967 implementation = 0x5ee71b30db71cee806f0d5cbbd57bfe1da3b2875 = DGLDTokenV3); proxy admin = OZ ProxyAdmin contract 0xd8b4395aafd4076ad7fa5b8c0bcd6da79750e629 whose owner() = same EOA 0xb1c1bc... The same EOA controls minting, role admin, and contract upgrades.

controls.label: DGLD Base MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE — issuer EOA
controls.evidence: The former OP-bridge representation at 0xd02f50e1017f493ffffa70c8fcf09e349e11d6c9 was paused and deprecated on June 30, 2026. On the replacement native Base DGLD proxy at 0xe908475f8beb7a138b0dc6eb5a05cb27068ffb9a, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE resolve to issuer EOA 0xE003a81a40803FedB701870c589C0A96D14544A0; both roles were read against the current deployment after the bridge closure.
